en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Muhammad Bin Is’haq Bin Ammar, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the surfaces in which there is Mention of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Wash it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Muhammad ibn Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar from abu al-Hassan Musa (a.s.)
who has said the following: “The Imam (a.s.) was asked about the surfaces on which a mention of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, is written. The Imam said, ‘Wash it clean.’”
